_post.post_content: How universal hospitals streamlined patient flow and improved surgical throughput by adopting Healthray integrated software
_post.post_title: Transforming Healthcare Operations At Universal Hospitals

fields.quote_text: "We just don't react and now we plan proactively and that's what makes the real difference"

solutions.title: Aids in Surgical Treatments
solutions.text: Healthray has helped universal hospitals in surgical treatments by providing a comprehensive digital platform that simplifies the entire surgical hospital. Doctors can easily access patient histories, lab results and imaging reports, which makes the preoperative assessment more accurate.

solutions.title: Cost Saving and Care Enhancement
solutions.text: Healthray has incredibly reduced hospital operation expenses. Universal Hospitals got relief from manual record keeping and paper storage charges, and staff overtime has been reduced. With Healthray software, physicians are no longer dependent on bulky charts.

solutions.title: Resource Optimization
solutions.text: The adoption of digital record management and automated workflows has reduced the paper usage of hospitals from 2,000 pages per day to only 200 pages. This saves the cost of paper printing and storage expenses up to Rs 8 lakh per year.

solutions.title: Revenue Growth
solutions.text: The combination of optimized operations and accurate billing has delivered 10–15% revenue growth in the initial first year. Healthray's AI-driven billing automation and real-time error detection features have minimized claim denials and payment delays.
